page.content:
Dragon of the West — Zuko's uncle and tea-loving general.

How Iroh connects

  • Character: Zuko — Iroh guides Zuko away from Ozai's path.
  • Faction: Fire Nation — Iroh is a Fire Nation general and uncle to the throne.

What is Iroh?

Iroh is the retired general and firebending master who steers Zuko with tea, pai sho, and a grief that makes him the Fire Nation's gentlest voice.

Key threads lead to Zuko and Fire Nation.
